text: S617 tested a distinct source-backed hypothesis: the production writer and pinned source contain true-centimeter coordinates but omit unit metadata. Adding only $INSUNITS=5 to a disposable unchanged-geometry copy fixed the 0.1x scale for this Standard-DXF CLO import. Nine pieces imported/exported/reimported without a format error (with CLO's informational seam-allowance Custom-mode notice), but high-resolution comparison passes CUT only 4/9 and SEW 9/9 at 0.001 cm; five CUT paths each lose a vertex by ~0.013–0.014 cm. This remains one Polo M fixture, not a qualified industrial profile or exact compatibility claim. Keep all seven-recipe acceptance and every V03 hold.
